_note: 學習路徑內容第24批 #6／6：目的與結果子句 purpose/result（eng.t_adv.conj.purpose-result，學測級／高階）。so that + 子句＝目的（常搭 can/could/would）：She left early so that she could catch the train。so + 形容詞/副詞 + that + 子句＝結果：He was so tired that he fell asleep。such + (a/an) + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that＝結果：It was such a good film that ...。in order to / so as to + 原形＝目的。誘答鎖『so↔such 用法／so that（目的）vs so…that（結果）混用／so that 後誤接原形而非子句』等唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix prs_）。

units.can_do: 我能用 so that + 子句表目的、so + 形容詞 + that 與 such + 名詞片語 + that 表結果，並用 in order to + 原形表目的。
units.situation_group: 連接詞：目的與結果子句
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'so that' introduces a purpose clause (a subject + verb, often with can/could/would): 'She left early so that she could catch the train.'
claims.verification_ref: so that 引導目的子句（主詞+動詞，常搭 can/could/would）：She left early so that she could catch the train；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'so + adjective/adverb + that' introduces a result clause: 'He was so tired that he fell asleep at his desk.' Use 'so' directly before an adjective or adverb.
claims.verification_ref: so + 形容詞/副詞 + that 表結果（He was so tired that he fell asleep）；so 直接接形容詞/副詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'such + (a/an) + adjective + noun + that' introduces a result clause: 'It was such a boring lecture that many students fell asleep.' Use 'such' before a noun phrase, 'so' before an adjective or adverb alone.
claims.verification_ref: such + (a/an) + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that 表結果（such a boring lecture that ...）；such 接名詞片語、so 接單獨形容詞/副詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'in order to' (and 'so as to') is followed by the base verb and expresses purpose: 'She studies hard in order to enter a good university.' Compare 'so that', which is followed by a clause with its own subject and verb.
claims.verification_ref: in order to / so as to + 原形表目的（in order to enter a good university）；so that 則接有主詞動詞的子句；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'so that' introduces a purpose clause (subject + verb, often with can/could/would): She left early so that she could catch the train.
teach.zh_hint: so that + 子句＝目的（常搭 can/could/would）。

teach.body: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.
teach.zh_hint: 她說得很慢，好讓大家都聽得懂。so that + 子句表目的。

teach.body: 'so + adjective/adverb + that' shows a result: He was so tired that he fell asleep. Use 'such + (a/an) + adjective + noun + that' before a noun phrase: It was such a good film that we watched it twice.
teach.zh_hint: so + 形容詞 + that＝結果；such + 名詞片語 + that＝結果。

teach.body: The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
teach.zh_hint: 箱子太重了，我搬不動。so + 形容詞 heavy + that 表結果。

teach.body: 'in order to' (and 'so as to') is followed by the base verb and shows purpose: She studies hard in order to enter a good university. 'so that' instead takes a full clause.
teach.zh_hint: in order to + 原形＝目的；so that 接完整子句。

teach.body: He got up early in order to catch the first train.
teach.zh_hint: 他早起是為了趕上第一班火車。in order to + 原形 catch 表目的。

practice.stem: 選正確：I wrote it down ____ I wouldn't forget.（以免忘記；後接完整子句）

distractor_rationales.because: because 引導原因（因為…），語意相反；『以免忘記』是目的，要用 so that。
distractor_rationales.such: such 用在名詞片語前（such a ... that），不引導這裡的目的子句。
distractor_rationales.that: 單獨的 that 在這裡無法表達『為了…』的目的；要用 so that。

practice.feedback: so that I wouldn't forget：so that + 子句表目的。

practice.stem: 選正確：He was ____ tired that he fell asleep at his desk.（太累了以致於…）

distractor_rationales.such: such 用在名詞片語前（such a tired man）；單獨形容詞 tired 前要用 so。
distractor_rationales.so that: so that 是目的連接詞；這裡是『so + 形容詞 + that』的結果句型。
distractor_rationales.very: very 不會連到後面的 that 結果子句；表『如此…以致於』要用 so…that。

practice.feedback: so tired that…：so + 形容詞 + that 表結果。

practice.stem: 選正確：It was ____ a boring lecture that many students fell asleep.（如此無聊的一場演講）

distractor_rationales.so: so 直接接形容詞（so boring）；但後面是『a boring lecture』名詞片語，要用 such。
distractor_rationales.very: very 不會連到後面的 that 結果子句；要用 such…that。
distractor_rationales.so that: so that 是目的連接詞，不用於這個『such + 名詞片語 + that』結果句型。

practice.feedback: such a boring lecture that…：such + 名詞片語 + that 表結果。

practice.stem: 選正確：She studies hard ____ enter a good university.（為了…；後接原形動詞）

distractor_rationales.so that: so that 後面要接有主詞動詞的子句（so that she can enter），不直接接原形 enter。
distractor_rationales.so: 單獨的 so 不表達這裡的目的；而且後接原形要用 in order to。
distractor_rationales.in order that: in order that 後面也要接完整子句，不直接接原形 enter。

practice.feedback: in order to enter：in order to + 原形表目的。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（他太矮了，搆不到架子）
practice.answer: He is so short that he can't reach the shelf.
options: He is so short that he can't reach the shelf.
He is such short that he can't reach the shelf.
He is so short so that he can't reach the shelf.
He is very short that he can't reach the shelf.

distractor_rationales.He is such short that he can't reach the: 單獨形容詞 short 前要用 so，不用 such（such 接名詞片語）。
distractor_rationales.He is so short so that he can't reach th: 結果句型是 so…that，不要混入目的連接詞 so that。
distractor_rationales.He is very short that he can't reach the: very 不能引導後面的 that 結果子句；要用 so…that。

practice.feedback: so short that…：so + 形容詞 + that 表結果。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：so that（目的）、everyone could understand（子句）、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。so…that／so that 連讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: He was so tired that he fell asleep.
lines.intonation: so tired that 連讀、asleep 句尾下收

lines.text: I left early so that I could catch the train.
lines.intonation: so that 連讀、train 句尾下收
